cases.question: Does Xero connect to my bank account automatically?
cases.checking: Uses the bank feed evidence from the AU product page.

Xero lets you connect your bank accounts to keep your records up to date (E2), and most banks can be connected to Xero automatically via a secure direct feed for daily updates (E2). Xero also states that you can connect your business bank accounts and track expenses (E1). cases.answer:
The evidence covers pricing, plans, features, payroll and invoicing only for two region-specific pricing pages and one Australian overview page, so a full picture cannot be given.

Pricing and plans (Australia): the Australian pricing page shows the Grow plan at "$7.80 per month" and "Then $78 per month", and names Grow, Comprehensive and Ultimate 10 in its plan comparison (E1). It states that prices are in AUD and include GST, that Xero reserves the right to change pricing at any time, and that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled (E1). It also says that if you later decide to change to a less expensive plan you can do so 1 month after upgrading (E1). Separately, an Australian page says Xero offers several plans to suit different business sizes and needs and invites you to start a 30-day free trial (E6), and another Australian page states that purchasing any Xero plan gives the first month free (E4).

Pricing and plans (United States): the US pricing page shows the Early plan at "$2.50 per month" and "Then $25 per month", and names Early, Growing and Established (E3). It states that Xero subscription prices are increasing from October 1, 2026, that all prices are listed in USD and do not include applicable taxes, that subscriptions auto-renew monthly until cancelled, and that you can change to a less expensive plan 1 month after upgrading (E3).

Features and invoicing: the Australian Grow plan is listed as including Smart document capture basic extraction, Payroll for 2 people, a 60 day cashflow forecast, and claiming expenses and mileage for 1 user (E1). The US Early plan is listed as including sending quotes and 20 invoices, 5 bills, reconciling bank transactions, visualising performance with basic graphs, and a 30 day cash flow forecast (E3). An Australian page describes Xero as cloud-based accounting software, log-in-able wherever you have an internet connection, that tracks income and expenses, manages invoices, reconciles bank transactions and prepares financial reports, and it says Xero is ATO-certified for STP and automatically calculates GST and generates pre-filled activity statements that can be lodged directly with the ATO (E6). It also says Xero lets you connect bank accounts, that most banks can be connected automatically via a secure direct feed for daily updates, and that where automatic bank feeds aren't available you can manually import bank statements (E6).

Payroll: the Australian Grow plan is listed as including Payroll for 2 people (E1), and the Australian page notes that where a plan includes Payroll, Expenses or Projects, additional charges may apply if you go over the stated included number of users or people paid (E1). The US page lists the figure "$36 a month + $6 per employee/contractor" in its plan comparison, but the extract does not make clear which plan that belongs to (E3).

The Australian pages also offer to recommend a plan in under two minutes (E2), and include customer testimonials praising automated bank feeds, invoicing features and easy reconciliation (E5).
